scope: Native UO source preflight, not runtime verification
observed: EndStable checks Controlled, ControlMaster, IsDeadPet and Summoned, but not Commandable or PersistentMinion. A paid transaction internalizes the NPC, clears ControlMaster and adds it to the ordinary stable roster.
risk: An actual revived original is Controlled and not Summoned. Hiding pet menus and exempting native loyalty does not close vendor stabling; clearing its master conflicts with the class-minion lifetime/ownership contract.
next: Reject class minions before charging gold or changing ownership, while preserving ordinary pet stabling. Verify the native target/transaction path and class identity with negative controls before learned Revive enablement.
